article.title: UAW Vice President Kevin Gotinsky Statement on Toxic Spill in Toledo
article.author: Justin Mayhugh
article.content: We are closely tracking the toxic spill in Toledo affecting our members who live and work in the city, especially those at Toledo Assembly Plant. Our top priority is keeping our members safe, and we will continue to advocate that Stellantis puts safety first as we monitor the situation. Every worker has the right to a safe work environment, and the UAW has your back. Please direct any questions or concerns to your union representatives.
